reviewer: Codex root direct targeted primary review; agent review is separately labeled
limit: Specific mechanism passages only; no exhaustive novelty or patent legal claim review. Search absence does not establish firstness. Preprints are not verified accepted venues.

sources.title: Translation Caching: Skip, Don't Walk (the Page Table)
sources.coverage: Cached partial radix translations skip already-known prefix levels; virtual-prefix indexing and different cache organizations are old.
sources.judgment: Because this work covers common-prefix caching, L-W cannot claim prefix reuse alone. Cancelable prepare+priced PWC can match its PTE count.

sources.title: System and method for performing hardware prefetch tablewalks having lowest tablewalk priority
sources.scope: root direct disclosure FIG3/4 and priority logic, retrieved lines451–460 plus CANCEL; agent independent same disclosure review
sources.coverage: Low-priority prefetch tablewalk can be terminated/flushed by higher-priority real request; cancel on later same-address TLB hit; architectural modification/update has noninterruptible regions.
sources.judgment: Because legal interruption of low-priority walks is disclosed, releasing a walker for waiting A is not new by itself. Another-address actual buffer lease changing a COPY goal remains a specific hypothesis, compared to this complete control.

sources.title: Processor to detect redundancy of page table walk
sources.scope: root direct common-prefix matching/cache-level/hazard/replay disclosure and claim14 cancellation
sources.coverage: Compare outstanding addresses' shared prefix with walk-cache progress, cancel/replay redundant walks and reuse cache state.
sources.judgment: Because cancel/replay driven by prefix redundancy is disclosed, neither cancel/replay nor shared-prefix state is independently new. Different permitted destination sets do not follow from domain renaming.

sources.title: Dead Page and Dead Block Predictors: Cleaning TLBs and Caches Together
sources.scope: root direct §V-A, PDFp4, retrieved lines451–525; agent also targeted delayed-placement discussion
sources.coverage: PC/VPN history predicts DOA translations, bypasses shared LLT insertion and holds a small shadow/victim translation table for misprediction.
sources.judgment: Because no-fill/shared-cache bypass and request-retention buffers exist, those components cannot be independently claimed. L-M's proposal is a live output-assignment objective; its full control may still win.

sources.title: Dead on Arrival: Characterizing and Protecting Against Dead-Entry TLB Misses in GPU Microarchitectures
sources.scope: root direct §6, PDFpp6–7; agent also §7 composition
sources.coverage: DEPOT uses recent-eviction Bloom history, pending dead-entry set and per-entry protection timers; replacement falls back to ordinary LRU when all candidates protected.
sources.judgment: Because history-driven eviction protection exists, protecting a recently useful translation is not enough. Reviewed mechanism does not itself establish FREE-slot matching-capacity admission. This limited distinction is not proof no other work covers it.

sources.title: Trail: Scalable and Low-Cost Temporal TLB Prefetching via Page-Table-Embedded Deltas
sources.scope: root direct §5 overview and §7 model configuration; not full evaluation
sources.coverage: Stores learned PC-related region-transition deltas in leaf-PTE unused bits and uses them to prefetch likely future regions; its stated modeled walkers/PWC/prefetch buffer are actual priced structures.
sources.judgment: Because learned future translation preparation is covered, source->destination correlation or use of PTE-borne hints cannot alone claim newness. Semantic choice of an allowed output is distinct from predicting a fixed program stream, subject to nearest-work review.

carry_forward: MASK selective fill/bypass, DMA2018 prefetch/locking, DAMN/io_uring/pool recycling, SDM overlap, and normal allocator locality remain mandatory controls from round02/03. Their already-read scopes need not be re-scanned this turn.
